figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 7. Effect of compound 8 (EA) on cell viability and inflammatory cytokines in RAW264.7 cells. (a and b) Effect of EA on the viability of

group.

MAPKs (p38, ERK, and JNK). (b) Relative protein expressions of p-p38/p38, p-ERK/ERK, and p-JNK/JNK. (c) Effect of EA on NLRP3/caspase-
1. (d) Relative protein expressions of NLRP3/β-actin and caspase-1/β-actin. ##p < 0.01 compared with the blank control group; *p < 0.05, **p <
0.01 compared with the LPS group.
